findings.justification: An ultimate sortal (kind) supplies the principle of identity of its instances; it cannot specialize another sortal, which would give its instances a second identity principle (Guizzardi 2005; gufoshapes:KindShape).

A rigid or semi-rigid type cannot specialize an anti-rigid type: if every instance of the specific type is necessarily so, it would necessarily instantiate the contingent general type (Guizzardi 2005; gufoshapes:RigidOrSemiRigidShape).

limits: Instance data comes from an OntoGraph-specific file; OntoUML has no instance level.
Classifications by anti-rigid types (roles, phases, role/phase mixins) are snapshot rdf:type assertions with no temporal qualification.
